channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics API separates BYOK across GitHub Copilot from Copilot-hosted model usage, covering local BYOK via Ollama, Foundry Local, LM Studio and llama-server, with enterprise and organization reports at user and aggregate levels for 1-day and 28-day windows. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
item.description: StateBench tests long-context state tracking across four difficulty levels and finds recurrent and hybrid models generalize farther than transformers, while frontier models fail on harder tasks and longer inputs. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
item.description: In a real lung cancer case, Google Antigravity with Cheminformatics Skills let an agent search thousands of compounds, run matched molecular pair analysis, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles and synthesis routes within an hour, versus days for typical iteration. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
item.description: OpenAI’s Astra test had GPT-6 define requirements and design the enclosure, PCB and software integration, with two team members building a Codex-chatting test unit in under a week and a contract manufacturer delivering prototype batches in under a month. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language
item.description: IBM Research's Palette fine-tunes a 20B model with LoRA, splits deck-building into designer planning and coder page-by-page code, speeds the coding stage about 6–7x, and ranks first in two of three PresentBench domains. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Dependabot version updates support Agent Package Manager
item.description: Dependabot version updates now support Agent Package Manager, opening pull requests for git dependencies declared in apm.yml, regenerating apm.lock.yaml, and covering version rather than security updates on all GitHub plans, with GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24 support coming. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
item.description: Cisco pairs network telemetry with OpenAI models under zero data retention and verifiable isolation, embedding security controls across microservices, containers and clusters while using Daybreak to find and patch vulnerabilities faster. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?
item.description: Holding the model constant across 90 AppWorld tasks, IBM Research's three-harness comparison of CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents moved completion from 30% to 81%, with CUGA pitched at enterprises needing enforced rules and in-boundary deployment. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Starting in 2027, AI and search services will be off by default for K-12 student accounts; disabling AI will also mean losing access to traditional search
item.description: Google will default Gemini and Google Search off for K-12 student accounts starting in 2027, requiring school authorization, and disabling AI will also remove access to traditional search. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
item.description: GitHub Copilot now works in JetBrains Air via the Agent Client Protocol, letting developers delegate coding tasks and review results in the IDE or cloud, where tasks run in Docker containers without retained state. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
item.description: Heimstaden uses OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to overhaul residential property management across Europe, cutting virtual staging costs in the Netherlands from about €50 to under €0.10, a drop of more than 99%. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Citing AI and organizational efficiency, Canva launches major restructuring
item.description: Canva is restructuring 1,271 employees—22% of its workforce—as CEO Melanie Perkins cites its first growth slowdown in nearly a decade, merging product, growth and platform teams and moving some roles to its Sydney headquarters. (AIbase)

item.title: Look up a resource’s cost center with the GitHub REST API
item.description: GitHub's new REST API endpoint identifies the cost center for a user, organization, repository or enterprise team by resource type and name, returning its ID and name—or empty memberships—without scanning every cost center. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Anthropic's product team sees shakeup as Claude Code lead departs
item.description: Cat Wu, who joined Anthropic in August 2024 and led product for Claude Code and Cowork, said on X that Friday was her last day, without giving a reason or destination. (AIbase)

item.title: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 features and JSON data extensions
item.description: CodeQL 2.27.3, the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, adds Python 3.15 language features, JSON syntax for data extensions and C23 bit-precise integers, while improving multi-language analysis accuracy. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Anthropic releases open-source system FlashProve to make AI model identities verifiable via cryptographic fingerprints
item.description: Anthropic open-sourced FlashProve on November 3, 2026, a system that uses cryptographic fingerprints to verify AI model identity without exposing weights, so users can detect when a provider silently swaps the model behind an API. (AIbase)

item.title: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15
item.description: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15, letting all github.com users upgrade projects while still receiving dependency updates, with the capability also slated for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: OpenAI announces major hire of former Uber president Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
item.description: OpenAI hired former Uber president and chief corporate affairs officer Jill Hazelbaker as its chief corporate affairs officer on November 4, filling a post vacant nearly a year; she starts in early December and reports to Greg Brockman. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
item.description: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 and later now gives eligible accounts short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens, reducing a leaked token's usable window and auto-renewing them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, though the rollout excludes GitHub Enterprise Server. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Seedance's overseas revenue reaches 50% share, up nearly 5x in six months
item.description: Overseas revenue now accounts for 50% of Seedance’s total, with ByteDance’s video-generation model posting nearly 5x growth abroad in half a year, while an MPA agreement and a Disney-TikTok 100-film cooperation support copyright compliance. (AIbase)
